description: Final integration: WCAG 2.1 AA audit, mobile responsiveness at 320px, language toggle wiring across all pages, root package.json dev script, README.md, .env.example files, and the full smoke test checklist. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003. No new features — this FEAT brings everything to a shippable state.
steps: Finalize root package.json (at c:\Users\giris\Desktop\New folder (11)\empowerher\package.json): scripts { 'dev': 'concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"', 'install:all': 'npm i && npm i --prefix client && npm i --prefix server' }. Confirm concurrently is installed at root.

WCAG 2.1 AA audit — apply fixes across all client components: (a) Replace saffron #F5A623 with #C47F00 for ALL text on white/light backgrounds (saffron only as decorative background fill). (b) Add focus:ring-2 focus:ring-secondary to every interactive element that lacks it. (c) Add aria-label to every icon-only button (hamburger menu, close modal X, bookmark icon). (d) Confirm every has an explicit

Mobile responsiveness at 320px — audit all pages: (a) Navbar: hamburger icon on <640px (sm:hidden / block sm:flex pattern). Mobile menu slides in as full-width overlay. (b) Homepage: need cards grid goes from 2-col (sm) to 1-col on 320px. District dropdown full-width. (c) SchemeFinder: sidebar stacks above results on mobile (flex-col on <768px). (d) All admin tables: wrap in <div className='overflow-x-auto'> so they scroll horizontally rather than break layout. (e) DonationFlow: single-column on mobile. (f) Admin modals: full-screen on mobile (<640px).

Language toggle wiring — verify all public pages pass lang from useLanguage() to SchemeCard and all Hindi-text components. Pages to confirm: Home.jsx (pass lang to SchemeCard in featured schemes), SchemeFinder.jsx (pass lang to results SchemeCards), SchemeDetail.jsx (show title_hi or title_en based on lang in page title/breadcrumb). Navbar HI|EN button must call toggleLang() and visually indicate active language.

Write README.md at project root (c:\Users\giris\Desktop\New folder (11)\empowerher\README.md). Include all 7 sections from plan.md item 40: project overview, tech stack, setup instructions (prerequisites Node 20+, clone + npm run install:all, copy .env.example to .env in both dirs, fill vars, npm run dev), test credentials (admin@empowerher.org/Admin@123 and donor@test.com/Donor@123), Razorpay test cards (success: 4111111111111111, failure: 4000000000000002), seeding command (cd server && npm run seed), known limitations (mock AI draft, test-mode payments, Ethereal email, Cloudinary optional, WCAG manual testing needed, 80G receipts not legally valid).
Run the full smoke test checklist from plan.md item 41. For each item, fix any failure before moving to the next. Document each fix briefly in FEAT-004.json findings field.

Confirm both .env.example files exist (server/.env.example and client/.env.example) and are not in .gitignore (they should be committed — only .env should be gitignored). Confirm .gitignore excludes: node_modules, dist, .env, server/uploads/, *.pdf.
